value.rationale: At the natural symmetric Allee threshold a unique cubic Chebyshev tuning supplies a rigorous exactly solvable regime, and the nontrivial mortality interval shows the leading normal Lyapunov exponent cannot distinguish finite-time instability. The exact, positive Gaussian variance pi^2/6 and non-asymptotic correction quantify the missing normal fluctuation invariant. Unlike the familiar degree-two derivative coboundary with bounded variance, this tripling normal cocycle accumulates a genuinely diffusive log-amplitude. This is meaningful real dynamics though the large invariant interval is not biologically positive.
